text: Thousands of prebuilt triggers and actions for integrated apps
quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps

text: One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for hundreds of APIs, usable in code or prebuilt actions
quote: One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for more than APIs (use tokens directly in code or with pre-built actions)

text: MCP integration lets an agent call tools across 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ actions
quote: Add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools.

text: End users can connect their own accounts without you building the OAuth flow or token storage
quote: the ability for your users to easily connect their accounts without having to build any of the authorization flow or handle token storage

text: MCP server automatically handles auth for tool calls with no extra implementation
quote: This is handled automatically by Pipedream's MCP server and there's no additional implementation required

text: REST API lets you create workflows, manage event sources, and handle subscriptions programmatically
quote: Use the REST API to create workflows, manage event sources, handle subscriptions, and more.

text: CLI can deploy an event source from local or remote code
quote: Deploy an event source from local or remote code.

text: pd dev links a local file to a deployed component and live-syncs changes on save
quote: pd dev will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes. When you save changes to your local file, your component will automatically be updated on Pipedream.

text: CLI can fetch historical events and stream live emitted events from a source
quote: Returns historical events sent to a source, and streams emitted events directly to the CLI.

text: Workflows support Node.js code at any step, including most npm packages
quote: Pipedream supports writing Node.js v at any point of a workflow. Anything you can do with Node.js, you can do in a workflow. This includes using most of npm's 400,000+ packages.

text: Built-in $.export helper creates a named export of step data for use downstream
quote: Alternatively, use the built in $.export helper instead of returning data. The $.export creates a named export with the given value.

text: Workflows can be triggered by app events, webhooks, schedules, email, or RSS
quote: Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS

text: You can select a specific test event and manually trigger a workflow run with it
quote: Then you can select a specific test event and manually trigger your workflow with that event data by clicking Send Test Event.

text: Failed events can be automatically retried, helpful for transient API errors
quote: You can automatically retry events that yield an error. This can help for transient errors that occur when making API requests

text: Pipedream emails you automatically when a workflow throws an unhandled error
quote: By default, Pipedream sends an email when a workflow throws an unhandled error.

text: Error details and stack traces are surfaced, with AI-assisted debugging available
quote: Pipedream will surface details about the error and the stack trace, and you can even debug these errors with AI.

text: Official TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs plus a REST API for the Connect service
quote: Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.

text: Connect API uses an external_user_id parameter to manage per-end-user account connections
quote: When you use the Connect API, you'll pass an external_user_id parameter when initiating account connections and retrieving account info.

text: API endpoint returns Connect usage data including credit consumption and end user counts
quote: Use the List usage records API to retrieve detailed Connect usage data for a given time window, including credit consumption and end user counts.

text: Simple, low-volume workflows can be run at no cost
quote: we believe anyone should be able to run simple, low-volume workflows at no cost

text: Workflows can run arbitrary Node.js, Python, Golang, or Bash code and import packages from those ecosystems
quote: Pipedream allows you to run any Node.js, Python, Golang, or Bash code. You can import any package from the languages' package managers, connect to any Pipedream connected app, and more.

text: Events emitted by sources can be consumed via REST API or a private real-time SSE stream
quote: You can also consume events emitted by sources using Pipedream's REST API or a private, real-time SSE stream.

text: AI agents can be prompted, run, edited, and deployed in seconds
quote: Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds.

text: pd deploy provides an interactive menu to select and deploy an event source
quote: Deploy an event source from local or remote code. Running `pd deploy`, without any arguments, brings up an interactive menu asking you select a source.

text: Platform is low-code: use pre-built components for common actions or write custom code when needed
quote: Pipedream is "low-code" in the best way: you can use pre-built components when you're performing common actions, but you can write custom code when you need to.

text: Developers can contribute new integration components via a GitHub pull request
quote: You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
